name: ARC Finance Ltd
about: ARC Finance Ltd, a non-banking finance company, engages in the lending business in India. It offers loans and advances; and various financial services. The company also invests and trades in securities. The company was formerly known as ARC Modellors & Services Limited and changed its name to ARC Finance Ltd in February 1993. ARC Finance Ltd was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Kolkata, India.
